columns.name: Month Number
columns.description: Numeric code for sorting the months numerically.

columns.name: Month
columns.description: Name of the month the posting closed in.

columns.name: Closing Date
columns.description: The actual date that applications were no longer able to be accepted.

columns.description: A numeric code for the Bureau of Human Resources to reference a posting by.

columns.name: Job Code
columns.description: A numeric code to reference a Job Title.

columns.name: Job Title
columns.description: A specific name assigned to a Job Code referencing specific duties and responsibilities.

columns.name: Number of Applicants
columns.description: Amount of applications received for this  posting number.
